usage_contract_records.decision: Accepted opt-in adapter/documentation proof only. Zero new core primitives, zero new canonical relations, zero schema changes. B candidates remain generic composition design gaps.
usage_contract_records.definition: A Claim about an inspected source assertion is scoped to that source representation and preserves attribution without asserting the reported world proposition.
invariant: Claim.subject_id is inspected document Entity, not reported actor/target
Unknown historical applicability is never synthesized from core unbounded null bounds
No read/knowledge/event/state or independence verdict is generated
Core validator accepts ordinary legacy Claims without this opt-in adapter contract
Each distinct extracted proposition has its own predicate slot; do not reconcile a source assertion list as one single-valued predicate
usage_contract_records.existing_core_failure: Incorrect field composition can use source-content confidence for a world proposition; inherited partial adapter drops nested claimant/time fields from its core Claim value. Existing core atoms do not fail the ontic firewall; the gap is an opt-in usage/adapter contract. Additional demonstrated adapter failure: all distinct assertions from one source share inspected_source_assertion predicate, so singleton-value Belief reconciliation groups different propositions as divergent values.
rejected_alternatives: Separate SourceIdentity/Content/Reality confidence primitives: distinct propositions can already be separate Claims
New Knowledge object: lifecycle and warranted knowledge not established
Promote all sidecar relations: would overfit archival/event granularity
Opaque embedding of complete dataset called full semantic support: byte preservation is not a core composition contract
usage_contract_records.proposed_representation: Existing RealityEntity(document)+Evidence(external_ref)+Claim(attribute source_assertion/<original_claim_id>)+SUPPORTS; enriched Claim.value contains content scope, original attributed claim/time and actor descriptors. Generic lineage/reconstruction remain in sidecar. Predicate slot source_assertion/<original_claim_id> separates extracted propositions. This changes the opt-in projection, not legacy core reconciliation.
usage_contract_records.migration_impact: None to parents or legacy state. New proof outputs use same0.1.24schema. Optional fresh projection only, no automatic rewrite.
usage_contract_records.compatibility_risk: Low for opt-in adapter; payload consumers must not interpret confidence as world certainty. No generic core helper or persisted primitive is added.
tests_required: actual-case source-content versus world target counterexample
nested attribution preservation including current-system inspection diagnosis
old broad predicate produces heterogeneous source-assertion positions; new per-proposition query remains uncontested without world-truth promotion

promotion_gate_conclusion: No candidate demonstrates the need for a new core atom beyond existing Claim/Observation/Entity/Evidence/derived assessment composition. Cross-modality domain evidence strengthens B boundaries, not a new primitive.
